name: Stockworks Gold Inc.
summary: Stockworks Gold Inc., a natural resource exploration company, owns, exploits, explores for, develops, and evaluates mineral properties in Canada. The company primarily explores for gold resources. Its flagship property is the Cabin Lake gold-in-iron formation property covering the total area of 1,503 hectares located in the Northwest Territories. Stockworks Gold Inc. incorporated 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, British Colombia.
